 On Nov. 4 at Suwon KT Wiz Park, Game 2 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL KBO Korean Series between the KT Wiz and the Samsung Lions was held.
 After KT beat Samsung 8-7 in Game 1 the previous day, Game 2 features a starting matchup between KT's Ko Young-pyo and Samsung's Chris Paddack.
 In the bottom of the 10th inning of extra innings with two outs and the bases loaded, Samsung's Won Tae-in is preparing to pitch. Nov. 4, 2026
